definition: Either of two large muscles of the chest that move the arm and shoulder, consisting of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor. This is the anatomical Latin name commonly used in medical and fitness contexts.
translation: 胸肌（特別是指胸大肌或胸小肌）；胸部肌肉
example: The pectoralis major is the larger, more superficial chest muscle that bodybuilders often emphasize in their training.
